title: License vehicles that carry dangerous goods in bulk
what: Use a road vehicle to carry dangerous goods in a single receptacle over 500 L, or over 500 kg in a single receptacle, only if the vehicle is licensed.

laws.title: Transport of Dangerous Goods by Road and Rail (National Uniform Legislation) Regulations 2011 (NT)

sources.title: Transport of Dangerous Goods by Road and Rail (National Uniform Legislation) Regulations 2011 (NT)
sources.quote: A road vehicle must not be used to transport: (a) dangerous goods in a single receptacle with a capacity of more than 500 L; or (b) more than 500 kg of dangerous goods in a single receptacle; unless the vehicle is licensed under this Part to transport the goods

administration.who: Competent Authority under the dangerous goods transport law (NT)

sources.title: Transport of Dangerous Goods by Road and Rail (National Uniform Legislation) Regulations 2011 (NT)
sources.locator: s 59, words naming the body (found 18 Nov 2026) (current reprint)
sources.quote: The Competent Authority may, on application, approve a design for packaging for use in the transport of dangerous goods if satisfied packaging of that design: (a) will comply with, or is permitted by, Part 6 of the ADG Code;

reach.condition: if it carries dangerous goods in bulk (a receptacle over 500 L or 500 kg)

reach.condition: if it carries its own dangerous goods in bulk by road (such as fuel or chemicals)
